description: Smarte Strasse: Elektroauto-Ladestationen is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Industrielle Werke Basel. Der Datensatz zeigt die Inhalte, die beim Laden eines E-Fahrzeugs erhoben werden. Diese Daten werden von der E-Ladestation erhoben, die im Rahmen des Projekts «Smarte Strasse» in Basel installiert wurde. Diese E-Ladestation wurde mit minimalem Ressourcenaufwand montiert, indem man ein Kabelverteilkasten (KVK) um genutzt hat. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport, Energy, Industry and services. Its keywords are Elektroautos, Elektromobilität, Ladestationen, IWB, Tankstellen, Elektroladestation. The portal shows 4,159 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-11-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
